items.title: OCI Always Free "Wait, what?" × 36 ~For anyone who thinks, “It’s just a free tier.”~
items.summary: Cloud free tiers come with familiar assumptions: "it's time-limited anyway," "it's tiny anyway," "you'll get billed before you know it." OCI's Always Free breaks a surprising number of them. This deck collects 36 of those "Wait, what?" moments and checks/coding each one against official documentation.The 36 are grouped under six assumptions:1. "It's time-limited and then it's gone" → It stays2. "Free means one tiny VM" → More than a VM3. "You get billed before you know it" → No surprise bills4. "Features mean bolting on more services" → More than storage5. "You host MCP and a vector DB yourself" → Nothing to self-host6. "It's all free, so production is fine too" → Mind the gotchasEach one gets a single slide with a figure, an explanation, key terms, a note, and sources. Free tiers have limits, and their terms can change. Those points are collected as six "gotchas" and given the same weight as the good news.Written for people who use AWS or Azure but have never touched OCI, and for anyone who wants a no-cost environment for testing or learning.Information is as of November 2026. Database examples assume Autonomous AI Database 26ai on Always Free. Free-tier numbers change, so check the sources on each slide before relying on them. The views expressed here are my own and not those of my employer.Tell me which card made you say "Wait, what?" the most.
